mathematical_objects.F: The complete explicitly generated affine input list, including all membership/field equations; original generators remain present throughout.
mathematical_objects.homogenization: For a nonzero F_i of total degree d_i, F_i^h=sum_alpha c_alpha z^alpha h^(d_i-|alpha|). Homogenize each individual generator to its own true degree after exact field reduction; do not pad all generators to a common degree or squarefree-reduce modulo field equations.
mathematical_objects.J: J=(F_i^h) in S, generally distinct from I^h. T=(J:h^infinity)/J is an h-power torsion module. Only declared finite slices and selected representatives are constructed.
mathematical_objects.slices: For D>=0,k>=1,E=D+k<=8, C_Dk={f in S_D : h^k*f in J_E}. Record Q_Dk=C_Dk/J_D with complete ambient columns. Selected canonical classes and their polynomial representatives are separate records; equal dimensions do not identify their h=1 images.
mathematical_objects.dehomogenization: delta_D:S_D -> R_{<=D}, f -> f(z,1), is a vector-space isomorphism. A nonzero homogeneous polynomial cannot have zero affine polynomial image. But [f] in T localizes to zero and delta(f) belongs to I: its affine quotient class is zero. This does not imply its low-degree presentation contribution is zero.
mathematical_objects.degrees: D_h=degree of the recorded homogeneous representative, D=degree(delta(f)), k=the recorded h power, E=max degree of terms used in the original homogeneous certificate and the actually constructed search. Primitive representatives have D_h=D. Record all labels and every intermediate matrix degree; solver degree and verification degree can exceed8 and are charged independently. Record E_preprocessing_max and E_all_stages_max separately; never report the latter as <=8 when utility verification or final solver certificate expansion reaches higher degree. The initial E<=8 source arm constrains original-generator torsion-witness discovery; it is not claimed to cap the complete affine solver. Utility certificates may be checked compositionally against already certified accepted generators, but their actual expansions/storage/work are still disclosed.
mathematical_objects.utility: W_d(G) is the smallest K-vector subspace of R_{<=d} containing every listed G_i of degree<=d and closed under multiplying any current element by any monomial whenever the product has degree<=d. Build it by full-column exact RREF and multiplication to a fixed point. A candidate g is presentation-useful exactly when g is nonzero and g notin W_deg(g)(F plus previously accepted consequences). This is a presentation invariant at the declared d, not a nonzero quotient class and not a cost-saving assertion.
mathematical_objects.ideal_equality: Every accepted g=delta(f) carries h^k*f=sum a_i*F_i^h; dehomogenizing gives g=sum delta(a_i)*F_i. Keeping F proves (F,G_added)=(F) as ideals, including multiplicity. Root-set equality alone never substitutes for these witnesses. Solver Gröbner bases additionally require both inclusion certificates and a complete S-pair check.

counts.rule: All342 ordinary targets and every original source control remain scheduled. All18 Boolean exact-F2 support invariance/interpretation-audit slots and18 supplemental K12 randomized-null slots are preserved. A source-grounded independent protocol-review resolution must identify the intended support/field level before approval; the natural nontrivial realized-F2 interpretation is formally unavailable, without attributing those added words to the source. full_panel.curve_selection: Enumerate (A,B) by increasing encoded A then B in each curve field. Reject singular curves. Enumerate every field x and y to certify #E, factor #E by deterministic trial division, and take its largest prime factor N; require N>=67. Take the first three distinct coefficient pairs meeting this test, with their actual N and cofactor recorded. P is the lexicographically least non-O point of exact order N, found by full point enumeration and [N]P=O (N prime). Exhausting the finite coefficient list or failing any proof makes that slot unavailable; never substitute another field or change N>=67 threshold. Curves are reused only with full reacquisition charges per algorithm/target, with separately labeled potential amortization tables outside primary results.
full_panel.target_selection: For each declared target label use the SHA256 counter stream below to sample x uniformly by rejection to the field size, then sample one of the actual y lifts uniformly by rejection, reject O/noncurve or [N]R!=O, and reject target duplicate within that curve and phase across every earlier lexicographic parameter/seed label. Maximum65536 trials per target; retain all rejected records and costs. Absence is unavailable, not a mathematical negative. No discrete-log label is produced or supplied to solvers.
full_panel.factor_base: Prime: all non-O N-subgroup points with x represented by s binary digits0..2^s-1; both/all y lifts retained. Boolean: all non-O N-subgroup points whose x is in the fixed4-dimensional V. Solver polynomial digit domains intentionally include x with no rational subgroup lift; record their exclusion only during complete recovery. Construction includes full factor-base acquisition and cost.

seeds.encoding: UTF8 JSON array with no whitespace; entries are [domain,arm,b_or_n,m,s_or_4,curve_slot,phase,seed_index,purpose,counter]. Integers are decimal nonnegative integers and strings literal. Counter starts0. SHA256 digest interpreted big-endian; rejection sampling uses the largest multiple of the required range below2^256. Every draw/rejection carries its counter. A repeated hash stream seed or serialized cell label is an instrument failure; different labels that select the same target trigger target rejection above.
seeds.order: Lexicographic arm (prime then boolean),b/n,m,s,curve_slot,phase (calibration then holdout),seed_index. Execution within one run uses this order, except strategy order cycles by repetition as explicitly frozen below.

full_panel.policy_freeze: Every construction, matrix, candidate order, useful-consequence rule, null predicate, repetition and threshold is frozen before BOTH phases. Calibration only verifies the instrument and reports its own measurements; no policy is learned from it. Holdout may launch only after the full calibration controls are valid. A change suggested by calibration stops this version and requires additive amendment and new admission; no learned-policy placeholder is permitted.
residuals: GOAL-DREG still requires full-column Boolean n=12,15,18 and at least3seeds; this initial n12 arm cannot discharge that full ladder. n15/n18 require a separately frozen admitted successor, not automatic expansion.

primary.name: V_all
primary.unit: field coefficient slots in a full rectangular matrix
primary.definition: Maximum R*C over every actual matrix submitted or logically constructed in input conversion, torsion discovery, C/J quotienting, utility closure, solver and certificate production/independent verification for the target. R is raw rows before elimination/dedup and C the complete ambient column count; include all chart and pre-descent conversion matrices. Do not substitute nonzero count or final basis size. Compare candidate/plain_affine per matched ordinary target. Also report stagewise V and the full matrix inventory.

primary.name: W_total
primary.definition: Complete acquisition, formula construction, failed search, discovery, all solvers, root/chart/sign/subgroup recovery, certificate production and independent verification. Per target/method use median of3 frozen cold repetitions; retain all3. All helper processes count. Matched-null construction and oracle costs are itemized and charged in control totals; shared ordinary acquisition/oracle costs are charged fully to each strategy, never free amortization.

primary.name: H1_success_fraction
primary.unit: fraction of the fixed complete ordinary target slice
primary.definition: Target success means at least one certified presentation-useful consequence and W_total(new)<W_total(plain_affine), after all discovery and verification charges, with identical full original roots/recovered group solutions and valid controls. Report count/scheduled denominator for each field/phase/SAT-status slice; no field or SAT/UNSAT pooling. Unavailable/unfinished targets remain scheduled and prevent a completed statement, not treated as negative successes.

secondary: All (D_h,D,k,E) and actual construction/solver/checker degree traces; only certified upper bounds unless complete minima proof.
Per-matrix raw rows, complete columns, nnz before/after elimination, exact rank, fill, live allocated coefficient bytes, witness bytes and stored serialized bytes.

Exact base-field additions, multiplications, inversions, equality tests; bit-operation counters with implementation-defined primitive definitions locked before launch. Separate K12 operations from F2 coordinate operations and F_p operations.
Wall nanoseconds, complete CPU breakdown, peak process-group RSS/live allocations, spill reads/writes/bytes, total durable bytes and peak disk use; peak is not sum of disjoint peaks.
Successful/failed/null-unavailable attempt counts and their costs; SAT/UNSAT and every chart/recovery failure class separate.
All polynomial roots and chart-tagged roots, projected core tuples, y lifts, subgroup exclusions, ordered signed solutions and duplicate multiplicities.

Exact loss/fibers: for each core tuple store all tagged chart/u roots projecting to it, count M, record L=log2(M) as the exact symbolic log of integer M (undefined for M0). b is the maximum actually verified successors at each chart projection, sign expansion or dedup node; store per-node lists and witness bytes. No free compressed synopsis or group-information interpretation.
metrics.repetitions: Three cold repetitions per method on every ordinary and available null target, each with fresh independent state and fully charged input construction. Method order cycles [plain_affine,new,plain_homogeneous_then_affine,direct_exhaustive], then rotate left1 and left2. k0 identity wrapper is checked separately and its overhead/cost retained as control; no fitted timing correction. Independent checker is a distinct implementation/process within the8GiB group budget.
metrics.aggregation: Within each field/phase/SAT-status slice report every target pair, arithmetic median and nearest-rank empirical quantiles0.1,0.5,0.9,1 of W and V ratios, and worst-decile mean over largest ceil(N/10) costs. Also report every (b,m,s,curve,seed,chart) raw value and parameter-specific slice. No averaging of field operations across fields. No significance/general-population claim from these fixed few seeds; report exact finite fractions and distributions, without a fitted extrapolation.
metrics.success: All mandatory correctness controls valid and all scheduled ordinary targets and required randomized controls complete, with no source-resolution gate open. In each nonempty field/phase/SAT-status slice: median(V_new/V_plain_affine)<=0.75, median(W_new/W_plain_affine)<=0.8, and at least ceil(N/2) targets satisfy H1_success. Calibration and holdout must each meet the same frozen criteria separately. An empty SAT or UNSAT slice is explicitly no evidence for that class. Report the same ratios against plain_homogeneous and direct_exhaustive as secondary frontier rows; meeting the primary alone is not a Pareto claim.
metrics.falsification: After a valid complete controlled panel and resolved source gate, failing any preregistered effect/H1 condition is scoped evidence against this fixed algorithm/parameter prediction. An invalid certificate, missing root or corruption-test failure invalidates the instrument instead. Missing controls/construction, censored runs or infrastructure interruption are incomplete/inconclusive; no mathematical rejection.
metrics.uncertainty: Timing variation is exposed by all3 repetitions and min/max, and fixed-sample empirical distributions. No independence or asymptotic scaling law is inferred from deterministic seed labels.

stopping_rules: Exactly8 run units and the complete panel above. E<=8 only constrains torsion discovery. Do not extend E, n, fields, seed counts or policy during a run.

Stop before the next ordinary target on the first accepted invalid witness, ideal/root mismatch, missing exceptional solution, wrong full-column/rank claim, corruption acceptance, seed/serialization collision or cross-run state leakage. Preserve failed artifacts and classify instrument_invalid, with no adverse hypothesis transition.

8GiB aggregate live memory and one worker per run are machine protection. Spill/checkpoint under the owned run path with all I/O charged. Disk unavailability, inability to preserve evidence, process failure, runner/LOCKED mismatch or watchdog checkpoint is operational/inconclusive. No arbitrary total research wall-clock/CPU cap or automatic goal retirement.

For the actual randomized predicates try at most256 counter-ordered candidates, retaining failures. Before launch resolve the Boolean source support/field interpretation explicitly; do not make256 pointless identical F2 attempts. Missing accepted controls remain incomplete and cannot count as negative scientific evidence.

A mathematical or definition defect discovered before implementation returns revise through an additive record; no overwriting historical design. A calibration-discovered change stops this version and needs separate review, amendment and launch authority.
invalidation_rules: Stop before the next ordinary target on the first accepted invalid witness, ideal/root mismatch, missing exceptional solution, wrong full-column/rank claim, corruption acceptance, seed/serialization collision or cross-run state leakage.
